statement: Which of these is closest to 2 to the power 20, the product of twenty 2s?

choices.misconception: I multiplied 2 by 20 instead of multiplying twenty 2s together.
I worked out 20 x 20, swapping the 2 and the 20.
I doubled 2 to the power 10, about 1000, instead of multiplying it by itself.
I thought that ten more 2s multiply the answer by 10, so I took 1024 x 10.

hints: Start from a smaller power of 2 that is close to a round number.
Twenty 2s are two groups of ten 2s, so 2 to the power 20 is 2 to the power 10 multiplied by itself. Round 2 to the power 10 to a nearby round number first.
2 to the power 10 is 1024, which is about 1000.

solutions.reliable: Ten 2s multiply to 1024, which is about 1000. Twenty 2s are two groups of ten, so 2 to the power 20 is 1024 x 1024, about 1000 x 1000 = 1,000,000. The exact value is 1,048,576, far closer to 1,000,000 than to any other choice. The transferable idea: 2 to the power 10 is about 1000, so every ten 2s add about three zeros.

whyOnTest: Estimation questions offer numbers of very different sizes, so the test is keeping track of size, here with the rule that ten 2s make about 1000.
author: Devansh Sanghavi
